# Muhamed Muminović

> Team Lead and Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building web, mobile
> and real-time applications. Based in Novi Pazar, Serbia. Site: https://muhamedmuminovic.com/

## Profile

- Current role: Team Lead at WiLine Networks
- Previous: Open Kinetix, Native Teams, Sprinting Software, Hygge Software
- Education: MSc Information Technology, BSc Mathematics — University of Novi Pazar
- Languages: Bosnian (native), Serbian (native), English (advanced), Arabic (basic)

## Core stack

TypeScript · React / Next.js · React Native · Node.js · Go · PostgreSQL · WebRTC

Additional: JavaScript, Vue.js, Angular, Tailwind CSS, NestJS, Express, Java Spring Boot,
REST / GraphQL, Expo, MongoDB, Redis, SQLite, Supabase, Firebase, LiveKit, SIP telephony,
Git, CI/CD, Jest, TypeORM, Strapi CMS.

## Open-source projects

- AI StepNotch — human-in-the-loop driver for the Claude Code CLI (CLI + Electron viewer): https://github.com/mmuminovic/AI-StepNotch
- AI Code Walkthrough — VS Code extension for understanding AI-generated code: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=mmuminovic.ai-code-walkthrough
- react-native-qibla-compass — NPM package for Qibla direction from device sensors: https://www.npmjs.com/package/react-native-qibla-compass
